summary: Customer inquired about fixed deposit interest credit not received.

intents.keywords: हेलो मैं अनीता वर्मा मैंने एक एचडी खोली थी ...व्यास क्रेडिट नहीं हुआ।

issues.reason(s): Interest is credited quarterly, not monthly as expected by the customer.

intents.actions of agent: Checked the customer's FD details and informed about the quarterly credit cycle.
intents.resolution: Informed the customer that the interest is credited quarterly and the next credit will be next week.
